task: T2: add the gate-output writer to scripts/ralph-log.sh. Define `log_gate <task-label> <attempt> <output> <rc>` writing `log_path "$1" "$2" gate.txt`: the verify output in `$3` verbatim, then a line that is exactly `---GATE-RC---`, then `$4` on its own line. The extension is `gate.txt` and MUST NOT be `gate.log` — loop-doctor.sh:143 and loop-metrics.sh:36 both glob `T*-attempt*.log`, which `T1-attempt1.gate.log` matches, and one extra artifact per attempt would silently double every attempt count in the corpus. This writer NEVER invokes verify.sh; it only records output its caller already captured. Same LOG_OK guard, same `|| true`, same one-line stderr report as log_prompt. No call site.
